_README: Copy this file, fill it in, delete the _help keys (or leave them — they are ignored).
TWO RULES THAT CAUSE THE MOST EXPENSIVE ERRORS:
1. Every rate is a DECIMAL FRACTION. 6.5% is 0.065, never 6.5.
The builder refuses to run on a rate above 1.0 rather than being wrong by 100x.
An OpEx ratio is a % of EGI and recoveries feed EGI, so combining them is circular.

deal.name: Property Name
deal._help_property_type: office | industrial | retail | multifamily | hospitality | self_storage | other

property._help_units: Required for multifamily. Leave null otherwise.

acquisition._help_acquisition_cost_pct: Title, transfer tax, legal, diligence. Typically 0.01-0.02. Jurisdiction-specific — look it up.
acquisition._help_upfront_capex: Day-one capital from the business plan. Included in basis and in equity.

revenue._help_mode: simple = SF x market rent | unit_mix = multifamily/storage | rent_roll = lease-by-lease
revenue._help_market_rent_psf: $/SF/year. NET EFFECTIVE, not face rent — adjust for free rent and concessions.
revenue._help_market_rent_month: $/unit/month. Multifamily only. Memo when unit_types is supplied.
revenue._help_tenants: rent_roll mode: [{name, sf, rent_psf, lease_end_year, escalation}, ...]. Each lease grows at its OWN escalation.
revenue._help_vacancy_credit_loss: Structural vacancy + credit loss, applied to Potential Gross Income.
revenue._help_recovery_structure: gross | modified_gross | nn | nnn. Anything other than 'gross' requires expenses.mode = 'line_items'.
revenue._help_recovery_ratio: Share of the recoverable pool actually reimbursed. 0 for gross leases; 0.85-0.95 typical for NNN.

expenses._help_mode: ratio = % of Year-1 EGI, inflated (gross-lease / multifamily) | line_items = itemised (NNN / modified gross)
expenses._help_opex_ratio: ratio mode only. Anchored to YEAR-1 EGI then inflated at expense_growth.
expenses._help_line_items: line_items mode: [{name, amount_annual, recoverable, growth}, ...]. 'recoverable' items feed the recovery pool.
expenses._help_management_fee_pct: % of EGI. Use YOUR management agreement, not the seller's affiliate rate.
expenses._help_rollover_pct_annual: Share of SF rolling each year. Use the real expiry schedule when rollover drives the deal.

debt._help_sizing_method: ltv | amount | dscr. Lenders size to the TIGHTEST of LTV, debt yield, and DSCR — compute all three.
debt._help_covenants: DSCR is tested in the FIRST AMORTIZING YEAR. Debt yield uses the ORIGINAL loan amount.

exit._help_exit_cap_rate: Convention is going-in cap + 25-50 bps. Tighter than going-in is a bet on compression — state the thesis.

returns._help_discount_rate: Unlevered required return. Must exceed long-run cash-flow growth.

sources._help: Keyed by the Asmp_* name shown on the Assumptions tab. Anything missing is highlighted amber as UNSOURCED. Write it so a reviewer can reproduce the number without asking you.
